sources.title: Family reunification - State Secretariat for Migration

notes: GENUINE FOUR-TIER STRUCTURE confirmed, tightening progressively by sponsor status — a level of gradation not present on most other countries' family routes in this dataset: Swiss-citizen and C-permit sponsors carry a genuine ENTITLEMENT, while B-permit sponsorship is explicitly DISCRETIONARY ('may be granted') and adds an A1 language requirement, and L-permit sponsorship (short-stay) drops the language requirement but remains conditional. Deadlines confirmed (Art. 47 FNIA): reunification generally must be requested within 5 years, but only 12 MONTHS for children over 12 — a real and consequential shorter window for older children worth flagging distinctly. Refugees and provisionally admitted (F permit) persons face a further wait of 3 years before reunification, plus financial independence and adequate housing tests — not modeled as a separate group here given scope, but flagged as a real additional tier beyond the four modeled. No federal square-metre housing rule exists — cantons apply their own benchmarks, a genuine source of cantonal variation consistent with the rest of this Switzerland dataset.
